scope: Codex subagent probes and local deterministic MCP benchmark. Full ChatGPT operator acceptance remains unrun.

connectedReadOnly.layer: Actually callable OpenCode Connect tools in a Codex conversation; existing deployed catalog

repositoryLocate.prompt: Locate the repository document that owns coordinated connector/plugin rollback and verify its ownership rule.

result.verified: Connector rollback swaps current/previous; restoring native plugin path/configuration is separate.

legacyStatus.limitation: Current exposed legacy recovery status; new detail field is not exposed or deployed. One observation, not a benchmark.

limitations: Single observations; no percentile or speedup claims.
Timers cover only the scripted connector probe; source inspection, discovery, script setup and operator reasoning are excluded.
Response characters are JSON string length of returned connector results, not tokens or wire bytes.
New readiness selector is absent from the exposed legacy status schema and was not called on the live service.

deploymentIdentity.measurement: Not measured by these probes; native OpenCode release comes from returned status only. Source identity does not identify deployment.

localFixture.layer: local MCP SDK with in-memory transport and deterministic native fetch fixture
localFixture.limitations: Measures fixture processing and serialization, not network/service latency, ChatGPT routing, operator reasoning, browser health, live recovery or end-to-end workflow acceptance.

sourceIdentity.measurement: Source version and Git HEAD inspected after the recorded run in the same unchanged checkout; this is not a deployed release identity.

chatgptWorkflows.reason: Codex-connected read-only microbaseline only; complete ChatGPT prompt-to-answer run not performed.
No live mutating workflow run; requires authorized disposable repository.
No model turn or live worker fault injection run; lifecycle tests are separate evidence.
No live browser form mutation; fixture browser tests are separate evidence.
No live service outage or lease fault injection; source diagnostics tests are separate evidence.
